grouped_cv_feasibility.reason: At least one label occurs in fewer distinct feature groups than the number of folds, so every test fold cannot contain all labels while keeping identical vectors together.

preliminary_holdout.interpretation: Retained as the original preliminary 9-example holdout for historical comparison; it is not a dependable estimate.

cross_validation.variation: Population standard deviation across repeated fold scores; these folds are not independent confidence intervals.
cross_validation.balanced_accuracy_definition: Macro-average recall over all four fixed labels. A label absent from a test fold contributes zero recall; folds missing a label are explicitly listed and are not meaningful full-class tests.
cross_validation.pooled_per_class_note: Per-class precision, recall, F1, support, and confusion matrices pool predictions from all repeated held-out folds; each CPU is held out once per repeat.

leakage_checks.warning: Different CPU records with identical input features can occur in both sides of a fold. These are not duplicate IDs, but their shared specifications may make record-level CV optimistic for entirely unseen CPU models.

model_selection.rule: An alternative qualifies only if its mean macro-F1 is higher, macro-F1 is higher on more than half of matched folds, and its mean accuracy and balanced accuracy are not lower than the current decision tree.
model_selection.conclusion: No alternative met the consistency rule. Retain the current decision tree as an experimental reference only; no reliable improvement has been demonstrated.

group_aware_cross_validation.repeat_seed_strategy: Stratified group CV uses random_state=42 + zero-based repeat index.
group_aware_cross_validation.variation: Population standard deviation across repeated fold scores; these folds are not independent confidence intervals.
group_aware_cross_validation.balanced_accuracy_definition: Macro-average recall over all four fixed labels. A label absent from a test fold contributes zero recall; folds missing a label are explicitly listed and are not meaningful full-class tests.
group_aware_cross_validation.pooled_per_class_note: Per-class precision, recall, F1, support, and confusion matrices pool predictions from all repeated held-out folds; each CPU is held out once per repeat.

leakage_checks.warning: Groups are kept disjoint, but some test folds omit entry. The grouped scores therefore do not reliably evaluate all four classes.

feasibility.reason: At least one label occurs in fewer distinct feature groups than the number of folds, so every test fold cannot contain all labels while keeping identical vectors together.

interpretation: Labels are editorial assessments rather than verified benchmark ground truth. Repeated cross-validation on 30 CPUs is uncertain; its fold variation is descriptive and not a confidence interval. Grouped evaluation is not reliable for all four classes because entry CPUs occupy fewer than three distinct feature groups. The experiment is separate from production recommendations.
